figures.alt: Reflective radiant barrier installed beneath attic rafters above insulation and a service walkway
figures.caption: Confirm the roof assembly, ventilation path, electrical clearances, and safe work route before adding a radiant barrier. It should support the attic strategy without covering vents or trapping moisture.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Attic insulation held clear of an airflow path near the roof edge
figures.caption: The reflective layer needs the specified air space and must stay clear of hot electrical equipment, recessed lights, and intake routes. A well-installed material still fails its purpose if it blocks the ventilation path.

figures.alt: Plywood attic walkway leading safely over ceiling framing
figures.caption: Do not trade cooling performance for unsafe footing or crushed insulation. Plan durable service paths before the barrier goes in so future work does not damage the ceiling below.
